subject: Discovery recap + pick one of two demo brackets
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Ross <ellen.ross@novacore.ai>, Devon Lee <devon.lee@novacore.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + pick one of two demo brackets

Hi Ellen / Devon —

Thanks again for a constructive discovery earlier today. Quick recap and a proposed next step so we can keep momentum: 

- Key priorities you mentioned: model-hosting isolation, predictable latency under concurrent traffic, and tighter token-cost visibility for billing owners.
- Success criteria for a 30-min intro: (1) show latency/cost tradeoffs on a representative workload, (2) map how Dedicated vs. Private would look for Novacore, (3) clarify engineering integration points and SSO/scope.

To move to a short product overview + tactical Q&A, can you pick one of these two brackets? I kept them intentionally narrow to make it easy for your exec + infra folks to commit. Times are in PT; happy to convert.

Bracket A — Tue 25 Jun
  • 10:00–10:30 PT (Novacore exec + product)
  • 11:00–11:30 PT (follow-up split for infra deep-dive if needed)

Bracket B — Wed 26 Jun
  • 14:00–14:30 PT (compact demo + Q&A)
  • 14:45–15:15 PT (optional engineering deep-dive)

If neither works, please suggest two 30-min windows next week and we’ll align. If possible include your infra lead (I added Devon here).

Attached: discovery_notes.pdf (call recap), 30min-demo-agenda.md (short outline).

Next steps from our side: I’ll draft a short mutual action plan once you pick a bracket and we’ll confirm attendees + any pre-demo test data you want us to use.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 415‑555‑0192
